description: Taxonomy and operational protocol definitions for accessing official BIS and statutory knowledge source endpoints.

access_methods.name: Direct HTML Extraction
access_methods.description: Direct retrieval of static or server-rendered HTML pages containing structured regulatory or explanatory text.

access_methods.name: HTML Search Endpoint Query
access_methods.description: Parameterized search queries against official search interfaces (e.g. searching standard number, keyword, or commodity).

access_methods.name: Paginated HTML Catalog Scraping
access_methods.description: Traversing tabular directories and paginated listings of standards, laboratories, or compulsory items.

access_methods.name: PDF Link Extraction & Streaming
access_methods.description: Discovery of embedded normative PDF links (standards, amendments, product manuals, SIT schedules) followed by streamed download and SHA-256 validation.

access_methods.name: Statutory Gazette Search Engine
access_methods.description: Search against The Gazette of India repository for Extraordinary S.O. notifications by ministry and keyword.

access_methods.name: Online Database Registry Query
access_methods.description: Querying operative licence databases (Manakonline) or CRS registration status registers with CSRF token support.
